# Waste Heat Recovery Summary

## Description
This measure reports the amount of simultaneous heating and cooling that occurs in the building, as well as heat flows for potential heat recovery.

## Modeler Description
This measure depends on HVAC timeseries data, and can take a while to run.

## Measure Type
ReportingMeasure

## Taxonomy


## Arguments


### Output Timeseries
If true, the measure will output timeseries data. If false, only run period totals.
**Name:** timeseries_output,
**Type:** Boolean,
**Units:** ,
**Required:** true,
**Model Dependent:** false
